title.narrative: Supporting the Syrian Ministry of Health with equipped ambulances

description.narrative: Supporting the ambulance transport system and enhancing medical referrals between healthcare facilities in the Syrian Arab Republic.

To improve the readiness of ambulance services and the ambulance transport system by transporting patients and the injured to and from hospitals, contributing to saving lives, providing rapid intervention, and reducing mortality in all areas benefiting from the project. This includes supporting the resilience of the state in ambulance services and the ambulance transport system, strengthening the field ambulance and medical referral system, and contributing to alleviating suffering in the health sector. The overall goal is to provide ambulance and ambulance transport services, enhance the field ambulance and medical referral system, contribute to alleviating suffering in the health sector, and improve the capabilities and resilience of ambulance personnel, develop their skills, and improve their economic situation.

To improve the readiness of the ambulance transport and medical referral system and provide services with support in the form of (10) fully equipped ambulances to serve (7) million patients, in addition to providing emergency services on the roads as needed, and to empower specialized personnel.
